name: Industrial Pipe
summary: Industrial pipe run with a rounded elbow, bolted flanges and a floor support; for plant-room and factory scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the support foot stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: at s = 1 about 400 px wide and 680 px tall; use about 0.5 for a plant-room scene

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle rock, wobble = tilt, pop = pops in

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror (the elbow then turns up on the left)

author: krakujs
